constraints: Keep Terraform google_cloudfunctions*_function runtime (and any matching deploy config) on one Google Cloud Functions runtime ID that Google still supports.
Raising the managed runtime can require Node.js language and dependency changes; confirm handlers run on the replacement before deploying.

steps.instructions: Change the reported runtime from nodejs14 to a supported Google Cloud Functions Node.js runtime ID (see the replacement).
steps.title: Raise the Google Cloud Functions runtime

steps.instructions: Update every other Terraform google_cloudfunctions*_function runtime and CI deploy config that still pins nodejs14.
steps.title: Align other runtime surfaces

verification.purpose: Validate the updated Terraform google_cloudfunctions*_function declaration before deploy.

rule.summary: The Google Cloud Functions runtime support schedule lists Node.js 14 (runtime ID nodejs14) as deprecated on 2024-01-30 and decommissioned on 2025-01-30. Google no longer provides maintenance for that runtime.
rule.title: Google Cloud Functions Node.js 14 runtime is end-of-life
